description: This file exports a function 'runCallsiteGuard' that scans collected TypeScript files within a repository to identify and report violations based on callsite lines. It imports utilities for file collection and path resolution, and performs file reading and analysis to enforce callsite rules.

methods.name: runCallsiteGuard
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates collection, scanning, and reporting of callsite violations in TypeScript files within a repository.
